title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented Hofstra study environments, from reservable rooms and quiet library seating to collaborative workspaces and specialized collections.

cards.title: Spread Out Above the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Renovated individual and group study space
cards.notes: Choose an individual desk for focused work or bring a project group to the shared tables; sofa seating and egg chairs offer softer options.
cards.short_summary: A renovated top-floor study area with desks, group tables, sofas, and enclosed-style chairs.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra describes the renovated Axinn Library 10th floor as a dedicated collaborative and study space with individual and group desks, sofa-style seating, and egg chairs.
cards.access_notes: Use is tied to Axinn Library access and operating hours; check the library schedule before visiting because hours vary by term and holiday.

cards.title: Build the Group Session Here
cards.subtitle: Second-floor collaborative study areas
cards.notes: Bring work that benefits from conversation, or coordinate your visit with a Writing Center or Undergraduate Tutorial Program appointment.
cards.short_summary: A collaboration-oriented second-floor setting that also hosts tutoring support.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra states that the Collaborative Learning Center on Axinn Library's second floor provides multiple collaborative study areas and hosts Writing Center and Undergraduate Tutorial Program tutors.
cards.access_notes: Located on Axinn Library's second floor and open during the library's operating hours.

cards.title: Set Up for a Computer-Heavy Assignment
cards.subtitle: 24-hour technology lab in Axinn Library East
cards.notes: Use the Mac or Windows workstations for software-based assignments, then handle printing or scanning without relocating your study session.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock computer lab with printing, scanning, and staffed daytime support.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra lists Hammer Lab at 125A Axinn Library East as open 24 hours, with Mac and Windows computers, laser printers, document scanners, and IT support.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours. IT support staff are available 8 a.m.-8 p.m. during fall and spring semesters; campus credential requirements may apply.

cards.entity_name: Axinn Library Lower Level Study Area
cards.title: Take a Longer Session Downstairs
cards.subtitle: Renovated lower-level study area
cards.notes: Head downstairs when you want a defined library work zone; bring charging gear and confirm the day's Axinn schedule before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A designated lower-level study area documented in Hofstra's campus renovation archive.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra's facilities archive identifies the Axinn Library Lower Level Study Area as part of its completed academic and event facilities renovations.
cards.access_notes: Use during Axinn Library operating hours; current hours and building access can vary during exams, intersessions, and holidays.

cards.title: Work Beside Research Help
cards.subtitle: Main-floor reading room and reference resources
cards.notes: Set up near the reference collection when sources are central to the assignment, and ask a faculty librarian for research help when needed.
cards.short_summary: A reading-room setting near the main-floor reference desk and research assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra documents new study desks and chairs in the Axinn Library Reference Reading Room and places the library's reference desk on Axinn's main floor.
cards.access_notes: Available within Axinn Library's operating schedule; reference assistance follows separate desk hours.

cards.title: Reserve a Whiteboard Room
cards.subtitle: Bookable rooms for law students
cards.notes: Reserve online before meeting your group, keep the session within the daily limit, and borrow whiteboard markers and an eraser at circulation.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Law Library rooms equipped for individual or group work with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hofstra Law Library says its study rooms accommodate different group sizes, include whiteboards, and may be reserved up to one week ahead for no more than three hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for currently enrolled Hofstra Law students. Reserve up to one week ahead, with a three-hour daily maximum and valid Hofstra email.

cards.title: Use the Atrium for Collaborative Work
cards.subtitle: Sunlit study and collaboration space in Hofstra Law
cards.notes: Bring discussion-friendly work to the atrium, but check the Law School calendar first because the space also hosts events and speakers.
cards.short_summary: A naturally lit Law School atrium designed for study, collaboration, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra Law describes Leeds Brown Atrium as a sunlit space used for study and collaboration as well as events and guest speakers.
cards.access_notes: Law School building access applies. Event use can supersede informal study, so confirm availability before planning a group session.

cards.title: Meet Around a Shared Table
cards.subtitle: Casual group-study lounge in Hofstra Law
cards.notes: Use this room for conversational review or team planning, and leave quieter assignments for the Law Library's controlled study areas.
cards.short_summary: A casual Law School lounge explicitly intended for collaborative learning and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra Law states that the renovated Student Lounge in Room 229 provides a casual environment for collaborative learning and group study.
cards.access_notes: Located in Hofstra Law's Room 229; Law School building access applies, and the lounge is intended for law students.

cards.title: Study Scores with Listening Tools Nearby
cards.subtitle: Room 014, Monroe Lecture Center lower level
cards.notes: Bring score-based or listening work here; use the carrel seating, computers, or small-group room and keep recordings inside the library.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library with study carrels, computers, recordings, and a collaborative room.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra says the Music Library has five internet-connected computers, Wi-Fi, a Collaborative Learning Room, and individual carrel seating for 13 users with audio equipment.
cards.access_notes: Regular fall and spring hours are Monday-Friday, 9 a.m.-5 p.m.; weekends are closed. Hours can change for exams and holidays.

cards.entity_name: Zarb School of Business Core Skills Lab
cards.title: Practice a Presentation Before Class
cards.subtitle: Flexible workspace with private computer stations
cards.notes: Use the flex workspace for team rehearsal or choose a screened workstation with headphones for self-paced communication practice.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped learning lab for collaborative rehearsal and focused skills work.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra describes the Core Skills Lab as an approximately 800-square-foot facility with flex furniture, Zoom presentation capability, and eight private-screen computer workstations with noise-canceling headphones.
cards.access_notes: Resources are available to Zarb students, faculty, and staff and the wider Hofstra community; confirm scheduling and room availability with Zarb.
